import M5
import time
M5.begin()
from unit import PIRUnit
unit = PIRUnit((1, 2))
screen=M5.Display
screen.setBrightness(255)
screen.fillScreen(0xFFFFFF)
screen.setTextSize(2)
screen.setTextColor(0)
print("WEB_A_READY")
previous=None
while True:
 M5.update()
 value=int(unit.get_status())
 if value!=previous:
  print("WEB_A_PIR",value)
  screen.fillRect(0,0,128,90,0xFFFFFF)
  screen.setCursor(4,4)
  screen.print("WEB A")
  screen.setCursor(4,32)
  screen.print("PIR "+str(value))
  previous=value
 time.sleep_ms(25)
